findings.title: Scope-invalid architecture certificates were accepted
findings.evidence: Before fixes, xPSR bit9 in the no-padding frame, LI destination -3 aliasing register1, and unsupported ALU opcode all passed unchanged expected outputs.
findings.resolution: Actual verifier now rejects padding before offsets, validates ALU operation/operand width, and validates toy register/address/program/immediate ranges. All three independent in-memory probes reject; originals pass.

findings.title: JSON boolean and numeric type substitutions were accepted
findings.evidence: Before fixes, DMA boolean true changed to numeric1 and expected integer exception21 changed to float21.0 both passed.
findings.resolution: Declared balanced/cpu/dma inputs now require exact bool. Integer/float expected types now match derived actual types; floating tolerance applies only to actual floating model values. Both independent corruptions reject; baseline model fixtures retain correctly typed floating outputs.

findings.title: Macro spelling and instruction-byte sentence boundaries were ambiguous
findings.evidence: UINT 32_MAX and length6.77/ZF=0.05 joins altered the apparent macro or numerical statement; several count/word joins reduced readability.
findings.resolution: Reread actual corrected UINT32_MAX and separate quoted byte descriptions; count/program/reference joins are spaced.

findings.title: Module dependency profile cards were underspecified
findings.evidence: The literal several did not identify profiles in the front cards.
findings.resolution: Actual cards now list A,C,E, consistent with portable component, hosted harness and reused firmware scope.
